tagline.en: Slidell to the Tennessee line, mostly following US 11
tagline.zh: 从斯莱德尔到田纳西州界，大体沿 US 11 而行

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: I-10 and I-12 in Slidell, Louisiana
start.zh: 路易斯安那州斯莱德尔，与 I-10、I-12 相接

end.zh: 佐治亚州怀尔德伍德附近，与 I-24 相接

en: I-59 runs northeast from the edge of the New Orleans metropolitan area to the Tennessee state line just short of Chattanooga, clipping four states on the way. It shadows US 11 for almost its whole length and has largely taken over that road's long-haul traffic.

For more than half its distance it is not really a separate road at all. From Meridian, Mississippi, to Birmingham it runs concurrently with I-20, and the pair carry the same pavement through downtown Birmingham before separating on the far side. That overlap is why the route feels shorter to drive than the map suggests.

Outside the cities it is rural and lightly built: pine country through Mississippi, farmland and low ridges across Alabama, and a short mountainous run through the northwestern corner of Georgia where the road passes between Lookout Mountain and Sand Mountain with only a handful of exits.
zh: I-59 自新奥尔良都会区边缘向东北行，抵达距查塔努加不远的田纳西州界，沿途擦过四个州。它几乎全程与 US 11 相伴，并大体接手了那条路的长途交通。
全程一半以上的里程里，它其实算不上一条独立的路。从密西西比州默里迪恩到伯明翰，它与 I-20 共线，两者在伯明翰市中心共用同一段路面，出城后才分开。正因为这段共线，实际驾驶的感受比地图上看着要短。
城市之外，它乡土而简朴：密西西比境内是松林地带，阿拉巴马是农田与低矮山脊，在佐治亚西北角则有一小段山路，道路从瞭望山与沙山之间穿过，出入口寥寥无几。

en: Construction started at the southern end. Louisiana began work in 1958 on a replacement for US 11 across the Pearl River, and by the mid-1960s the road ran continuously from the Mississippi line into Slidell. Mississippi opened its first sections in 1963 and had the whole state south of the I-20 overlap finished by the end of the decade.

Georgia's twenty-mile share was the piece nobody wanted. The state highway department said in 1967 that the route was not considered important and was being built because the Bureau of Public Roads insisted. The interchange with I-24 was finished in 1968, and the last eleven-mile section through Dade County opened in October 1971.
Alabama came last, with the section of I-59 and I-20 through downtown Birmingham completed in 1973. That elevated stretch was itself demolished and rebuilt between January 2019 and early 2020.
zh: 施工自南端开始。路易斯安那 1958 年动工，修建跨越珍珠河、取代 US 11 的道路，到 1960 年代中期，这条路已从密西西比州界连续通到斯莱德尔。密西西比 1963 年开放首批路段，到该年代末，与 I-20 共线段以南的全州路段均已完成。
佐治亚那二十英里是谁都不想要的一块。州公路部门 1967 年表示，这条路线并不被认为重要，之所以要建，是因为公共道路局坚持。与 I-24 的立交 1968 年建成，途经戴德县的最后十一英里于 1971 年 10 月通车。
阿拉巴马最后完成，I-59 与 I-20 穿越伯明翰市中心的路段于 1973 年建成。那段高架本身又在 2019 年 1 月至 2020 年初被拆除重建。

why.en: No public figure exists. Four states built the route between 1958 and 1973 under a federal-aid programme that accounted for costs by state and fiscal year, and more than half the route's length was built jointly with I-20 and charged to that corridor as well.
why.zh: 无公开数据。四个州于 1958 至 1973 年间建成本路线，所属联邦补助计划按州和财政年度核算造价；而全线一半以上的里程是与 I-20 一并修建的，费用同时计入那条走廊。

value.en: 421.24 miles across 4 states; longest in Alabama at 239.91 miles, shortest in Louisiana at 12.06
value.zh: 421.24 英里，横跨 4 个州；阿拉巴马州最长，239.91 英里；路易斯安那州最短，12.06 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. Counts are collected per segment by four state transportation departments, and on the long concurrency with I-20 they cannot be attributed to I-59 alone.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。交通量由四个州的交通部门按路段采集，而在与 I-20 的长距离共线段上，这些数据无法单独归于 I-59。

timeline.en: Louisiana begins building a replacement for US 11 across the Pearl River — the first work on the corridor.
timeline.zh: 路易斯安那开始修建跨越珍珠河、取代 US 11 的道路，这是本走廊上最早的工程。

timeline.en: Mississippi opens its first sections, from the Louisiana line toward Picayune and from Hattiesburg to Laurel.
timeline.zh: 密西西比开放首批路段：自路易斯安那州界至皮卡尤恩，以及哈蒂斯堡至劳雷尔。

timeline.en: The interchange with I-24 in Georgia is completed, along with an eight-mile section leading to it.
timeline.zh: 佐治亚境内与 I-24 的立交建成，同时通车的还有通往该立交的八英里路段。

timeline.en: The last 11.8 miles through Dade County open on 25 October, completing the Georgia segment.
timeline.zh: 10 月 25 日，途经戴德县的最后 11.8 英里通车，佐治亚段全部完成。

timeline.en: The I-59 and I-20 section through downtown Birmingham is completed, finishing the route.
timeline.zh: I-59 与 I-20 穿越伯明翰市中心的路段建成，本路线全线完工。

timeline.en: The elevated Birmingham section is closed in January and rebuilt, reopening in early 2020.
timeline.zh: 1 月，伯明翰高架段封闭重建，2020 年初重新开放。
